test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Maintaen** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Maintain**." • The correct spelling can be remembered by breaking it down into two parts: "**main**" and "**tain**." • **Maintain **means to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc. (किसी वस्‍तु को उसी स्‍तर, मानक आदि पर बनाए रखना, जारी रखना) Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1** which is incorrectly spelt. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Boring **is correctly spelt and means something that is dull or uninteresting. (कुछ ऐसा जो नीरस या अरुचिकर हो) • **Stupid** is correctly spelt and means lacking intelligence or common sense. (बुद्धि या सामान्य ज्ञान की कमी) • **Gang **is correctly spelt and means a group of people who associate together for a common purpose. (लोगों का एक समूह जो एक सामान्य उद्देश्य के लिए एक साथ जुड़ते हैं) 3a:Ta99, The correct answer is: **Option 3 - "He stood outside the bathroom door."**
